## Mose 0.1.23 — first public release
Mose is a native macOS app for Logitech MX mice, and for mice from other makers too. It lives in the menu bar, with a full window for setting things up.
**Buttons and gestures** - Remap any button to shortcuts, apps, Shortcuts, Mission Control, desktops and more, per app. - Gesture button: hold and move for desktop gestures; hold a thumb button and scroll for combos. - Standard (non-Logitech) mice: remap their buttons (including 6–8 and wheel tilt), and use any button as a gesture button.
**Scrolling and pointer** - Smooth scrolling driven by the hi-res wheel, with settings per mouse. - Pointer speed and DPI presets, using System Settings' notches.
**Devices** - MX Master 2S / 3 / 3S / 4, MX Anywhere 3 / 3S, MX Vertical, MX Ergo / Ergo S, plus a generic mode for other Logitech mice. - Logi Bolt pairing, several mice at once, Easy-Switch channels with host names, and the keyboard following the mouse. - Battery in the menu bar and the macOS Batteries widget, with low-battery notifications. - Device images are downloaded the first time a mouse appears.
**And** - Usage statistics, launch at login, English, 简体中文, 繁體中文 and 日本語. - Mose now updates itself (Settings › Updates).
Requires macOS 15 or later.
